title: Quasi-coherent submodules and quotients of a coherent module on a locally Noetherian algebraic space are coherent

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that on a locally Noetherian algebraic space the quasi-coherent submodules and quotients of a coherent module remain coherent (statement lines 2151-2158). The proof pulls the situation back along a surjective etale morphism from a scheme, where pullback is an exact restriction functor, invokes the locality of the coherence condition for that cover, and quotes the scheme case. The reduction to schemes through the exactness and locality statements is the substance, so the claim is H2.
